title: The new geopolitics of 6G: Artificial Intelligence enters mobile networks
script:
6G is turning mobile networks into a major geopolitical battleground. AI is now at the heart of this race for infrastructure control.
Il Sole 24 ORE highlights how AI will manage these networks. This shift makes data sovereignty a critical national security issue.
Countries are positioning themselves to dominate the next standard. They want to define how AI integrates with future connectivity.
Nokia is a lead player in these 6G developments. They see AI as essential for managing the complexity of these faster networks.
The network will be able to self-optimize using AI. This efficiency is why governments are prioritizing 6G research right now.
Would you trust an AI to manage your country's entire mobile network?
